messageBody:
## Community Coordinated Modeling Center Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information ( CCMC DONKI )
## Message Type: Space Weather Notification - CMEs (Mars, OSIRIS-APEX, Parker Solar Probe, Solar Orbiter)
##
## Message Issue Date: 2024-05-16T02:22:38Z
## Message ID: 20240516-AL-001
##
## Disclaimer: NOAA's Space Weather Prediction Center is the United States Government official source for space weather forecasts. This "Experimental Research Information" consists of preliminary NASA research products and should be interpreted and used accordingly.


## Summary:

Multiple CMEs have been detected as follows:
1: O-type CME detected by STEREO A / SOHO. 

Start time of the event: 2024-05-15T08:36Z.

Estimated speed: ~1766 km/s.

Estimated opening half-angle: 31 deg.

Direction (lon./lat.): 105/2 in Heliocentric Earth Equatorial coordinates.

Activity ID: 2024-05-15T08:36:00-CME-001

2: O-type CME detected by STEREO A / SOHO. 

Start time of the event: 2024-05-15T08:48Z.

Estimated speed: ~1082 km/s.

Estimated opening half-angle: 24 deg.

Direction (lon./lat.): 114/-29 in Heliocentric Earth Equatorial coordinates.

Activity ID: 2024-05-15T08:48:00-CME-001

3: O-type CME detected by STEREO A / SOHO. 

Start time of the event: 2024-05-15T10:00Z.

Estimated speed: ~1205 km/s.

Estimated opening half-angle: 37 deg.

Direction (lon./lat.): 113/-6 in Heliocentric Earth Equatorial coordinates.

Activity ID: 2024-05-15T10:00:00-CME-001

4: O-type CME detected by STEREO A / SOHO. 

Start time of the event: 2024-05-15T10:48Z.

Estimated speed: ~1162 km/s.

Estimated opening half-angle: 39 deg.

Direction (lon./lat.): 109/-16 in Heliocentric Earth Equatorial coordinates.

Activity ID: 2024-05-15T10:48:00-CME-001

5: O-type CME detected by SOHO. 

Start time of the event: 2024-05-15T21:12Z.

Estimated speed: ~1269 km/s.

Estimated opening half-angle: 29 deg.

Direction (lon./lat.): 110/2 in Heliocentric Earth Equatorial coordinates.

Activity ID: 2024-05-15T21:12:00-CME-001

Based on preliminary analysis by the Moon to Mars Space Weather Analysis Office and heliospheric modeling carried out at NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center, it is estimated that the CMEs may impact Mars, OSIRIS-APEX, Parker Solar Probe, and Solar Orbiter (glancing blow).  The combined leading edge of the CMEs will reach Mars at 2024-05-17T14:19Z, OSIRIS-APEX at 2024-05-16T21:02Z, Parker Solar Probe at 2024-05-16T10:50Z, and the combined flank may reach Solar Orbiter at 2024-05-17T04:00Z (plus minus 7 hours).

## Notes: 

The CME event with ID 2024-05-15T08:48:00-CME-001 is associated with X3.4 flare from Active Region 13664 (S20W90) with ID 2024-05-15T08:18:00-FLR-001 which peaked at 2024-05-15T08:37Z (see notifications 20240515-AL-002, 20240515-AL-003).

The CME event with ID 2024-05-15T10:48:00-CME-001 is associated with M3.5 flare from Active Region 13664 (S25W90) with ID 2024-05-15T09:50:00-FLR-001 which peaked at 2024-05-15T10:35Z.


SCORE CME typification system:
S-type: CMEs with speeds less than 500 km/s
C-type: Common 500-999 km/s
O-type: Occasional 1000-1999 km/s
R-type: Rare 2000-2999 km/s
ER-type: Extremely Rare >3000 km/s
